guideContent.strategyOverview: This upgrade transforms Endless Punishment from a casual Bracket 1-2 precon into a focused group slug powerhouse. We're removing underperformers and slow lands while adding damage multipliers, punisher effects, and a premium mana base. The Lord of Pain prevents opponent lifegain and deals damage equal to the first spell cast each turn to a chosen player, making damage multiplication effects devastating. Valgavoth draws cards whenever opponents lose life on their turns, providing a card advantage engine.

budget.name: Death by a Thousand Cuts
budget.subtitle: Consistent Pings, Maximum Card Draw
budget.description: Ultra-budget upgrade focused on Valgavoth as commander. Every card reliably triggers Valgavoth on opponents' turns for consistent card draw and commander growth. Cheap enchantments and creatures that ping each upkeep form a damage engine, while fakeout death effects protect your commander on a budget. No expensive lands or damage doublers needed -- just relentless, unavoidable pain.

Every card is chosen to reliably ping opponents on THEIR turns for guaranteed card draw. Protection suite keeps Valgavoth alive as a growing flying threat that wins through commander damage or overwhelming card advantage. Includes radiation counters as a unique angle for persistent damage.

synergies.title: Repercussion + Blasphemous Act
synergies.description: 13 damage per creature, then Repercussion deals that much to the creature's controller. 2 creatures per opponent = 26 damage each. With Fiery Emancipation = 78 each. Caution: also triggers for creatures YOU control. Deploy with few or no creatures on your side.

synergies.description: Activate to deal half life to each player. With any doubler (Solphim/Dictate/Fiery Emancipation) = lethal to all players at even life. Survive by being at odd life total or winning in response to the trigger.

synergies.title: Bloodletter of Aclazotz + Wound Reflection
synergies.description: Your turn: 5 base damage → Bloodletter doubles → 10 lost. End step: Wound Reflection → 10 → Bloodletter → 20. Total: 30 from 5 base. With Archfiend too: Archfiend sees 30 → Bloodletter doubles → 60. Total: 90 from 5 base damage = any hit is lethal.

synergies.title: Draw Punishment Package
synergies.description: Each normal opponent draw = 6 life reduction: Sheoldred 2 life loss + Dreams 1 + Unraveler 1 + Parasite 1 + Razorkin 1. With Solphim: 10 per draw (Sheoldred's life loss NOT doubled — only damage doubled). Three opponents drawing 1 card = 30 per turn cycle. Orcish Bowmasters adds +1 per EXTRA draw beyond first. Wound Reflection doubles ALL life loss at end step.

synergies.title: Bloodchief Ascension + Group Slug
synergies.description: Activates in 3 turns (opponents lose 2+ life every turn in this deck). Once active, every card hitting opponent graveyards = drain 2. Board wipes, removal, fetchlands, discards — everything triggers it. Sustains your life total while accelerating theirs down.

sources.name: Claude analysis
sources.detail: Fast activation in group slug shell

synergies.title: Twinflame Tyrant + Repercussion
synergies.description: Blasphemous Act deals 13 to each creature. Twinflame doubles that to 26 per creature. Repercussion deals that damage again to the creature's controller. 2 creatures per opponent = 52 damage each.

sources.name: Claude analysis
sources.detail: Enhanced Repercussion combo with one-sided doubling

synergies.title: Day of Black Sun + Death Trigger Denial
synergies.description: Strips abilities BEFORE destroying. Opponents lose death triggers (Blood Artist, Grave Pact, etc.), indestructible, and regeneration. Clean board wipe with no blowback.

sources.name: Claude analysis
sources.detail: Ability-stripping wipe prevents opponent value

synergies.title: Peer into the Abyss + Draw Punishers
synergies.description: Target draws half library (~20 cards) and loses half life (~20). With Sheoldred alone: 20 draws × 2 life loss = 40 + 20 half-life = 60. Lethal. With Dreams + Sheoldred: 20 × 3 + 20 = 80. With full punisher package (6 sources): 20 × 7 + 20 = 160. Even targeting yourself is viable — draw 20 cards, lose 20 life, refuel completely.
